name: Hajimete Naita Hi
source:
Being alone is ok for main character, but he does not really want to be alone. Two girls appear in his life. Both of them feel hurt and lost. That's a similar, but also a very different environment. How will they affect the boy? And what can he do for them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
